summary: Frontend mobile (390x844) E2E test completed successfully for Burger & Grill site after logo replacement. All critical flows verified: new logo renders correctly across Hero, MobileMenu, sticky FilterBar, About, Bevande and Cart; correct sizes (Hero h-32/128px, sticky h-14/56px, MobileMenu 128px); natural 1024x1023 PNG loads fine; mobile hamburger accordion works; category images visible on mobile; language toggle IT/EN swaps aria-labels; 3 items added to cart → total € 32,50 → slot auto-selected (Pranzo oggi 13:30) → confirm modal → valid wa.me URL generated with full order text; Google /api/reviews returns 200; all external links (maps, wa.me, tel) present and valid.

issues: Logo (128px) + IT/EN toggle + about-info + hamburger menu buttons are cramped in the top bar at 390px width but remain functional (no overlap observed).
FilterBar height ~107px when sticky which consumes meaningful viewport real estate on small phones; acceptable but could be condensed.

critical_code_review_comments: CartDrawer.jsx useMemo dep array `[open]` for getPickupPlan is stale — should depend on `new Date()` trigger or interval; not a test failure but could show stale slots if drawer stays open across meal boundaries.
Hero.jsx imports RESTAURANT but never uses it (unused import).
Logo.jsx: drop-shadow amber glow is heavy on mobile, may impact paint perf on low-end devices but acceptable.
Consider adding data-testid='lang-toggle' (currently selected by text) and data-testid='cart-fab'/'cart-open-btn' for more robust E2E tests — found via text 'Carrello' and role button only.
